answer: Require each new key to fund a random 3D-printed calibration part at an accredited maker space; the printer signs a one-use spool serial and geometry hash, then an independent reviewer measures a randomly chosen dimension. The registry consumes the serial and rejects duplicates or out-of-tolerance parts. Proposed print and inspection fee is .75, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .75 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,750 (1,000 × .75). Bind the receipt to zenith/lagoon/garden. Limitation: printer access is uneven and shops can collude.
